set.body:
Diagnostic readout, development partition only: where do scene errors arise in the frozen 2026-09-23 A run (development-20260923/A stage traces, 11 participants, frozen support.json)?

Classes per gold-eligible unit: retrieval miss (no nominated source in gold scene), ranking miss (gold scene nominated but local top source elsewhere), decode loss / decode rescue, hit. Also local non-source dominance and candidate recall by level.

Purpose: direct the next engineering step after Codex's 2026-10-21 finding that the fixed-basis profile leaves source ranks unchanged. Not arm selection; no accuracy-improvement claim. Adds one development diagnostic to the scene-gold ledger. Protocol and script committed before the read: docs/refactor/evidence/mapping-decomposition-20261108/ on branch claude/mapping-decomposition-20261108.
set.title: Scene-error decomposition of the frozen 2026-09-23 development run (retrieval vs ranking vs decode)
